pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Sub-polygonal to irregular dark brown regions with smooth pixel-level edge gradients. Patch area is maximal on the mid-flank and decreases in scale toward the ventral and posterior regions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored interstitial pathways forming a topological graph with predominantly trivalent junction nodes. Corridor thickness is relatively uniform across the central flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrated 1D contour along the upper neck mane, visible as a jagged silhouette against the blurred background.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a yellow-billed oxpecker perched on the dorsal ridge at the junction of the neck and shoulder.
